historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as an auto showroom. Dated 1926–1927. Designed by Bernard Maybeck with Powers and Ahnden as associated architects, for the Packard dealership of Earle C. Anthony. The most theatrical of Auto Row's showrooms, and one of the two with the most elaborate interiors.
A Packard showroom into the 1960s, and an auto showroom still.
An automobile showroom built for Earle C. Anthony.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criteria 1, 2 and 3.
